# Export validation

21 actual native SWF -> XFL exports verified. 11300 frame positions evaluated from serialized native map assignments and linear base endpoints match reference.swf within one twip after rounding. Native map types, strengths, two base keys and full span lengths match. BounceIn 1 uses the equivalent native Quadratic -100 map.

This is local serialization/model verification. Native Flash CS6 recompilation is now verified for all 21 exports; see ROUNDTRIP.md for comparison of all 11,901 source positions.
